metadata.title: How Duolingo Decides What You Practice Next
metadata.narration_policy: Narration is SCRIPT.md verbatim, one script section per beat. Beat IDs B01-B11 match script sections 1-11; BVDT, BHTF and BOUT are sections 12, 13 and 14. On-screen-only lines and source tags in SCRIPT.md are not narrated.
metadata.visual_policy: Simple illustrative graphics only: a forgetting curve, flashcard boxes, a strength meter, a half-life curve, exercise difficulty. No Duolingo logo, owl mascot, app screenshots or other branding. Every meter, bar and tally is an illustration, not real data. The Claude composer, verdict page and channel mark are redrawn bookends, not screenshots.

fonts.rule: Every Manim Text containing kana sets font='Hiragino Sans' (or a listed fallback) explicitly; never the default font. Verify glyphs in the rendered frame, not the source.

portrait_layout.rule: In 9:16, all text and labels sit above 86% of the frame height (y < 0.86 * H), leaving the bottom 14% empty.

metadata.library_check: Searched with ./art scenes first, for: forgetting curve and decay, spaced repetition schedule, flashcard boxes (Leitner), strength meter and half-life curve, exercise difficulty band, typed-then-corrected overview, line chart of exponential decay, timeline of review gaps. Reused: ClaudeComposerAsk, BrutalistHesitantWriter, ClaudeVerdictArtifact, LogoOutro (and their 916 variants). No library match for a forgetting curve, Leitner boxes, a strength meter or a difficulty ladder, so B02 and B04-B11 are custom Manim scenes. Leads read and rejected: TtScaleDecay (reel-local, scale decay), K12Fig07ExpertiseReversal (reel-local, fixed chart), CwcMemoryTimeline (agent sessions), ThemeFactoryContrastMeter (contrast ratios).
